interactions.description: Increased risk of bleeding when taken together
interactions.mechanism: Both drugs inhibit platelet aggregation and affect coagulation cascade
interactions.management: Monitor INR closely; consider alternative analgesic like paracetamol

interactions.description: Increased bleeding risk and reduced warfarin efficacy
interactions.mechanism: NSAIDs displace warfarin from protein binding and inhibit platelet function
interactions.management: Avoid combination; use paracetamol for pain; monitor INR if unavoidable

interactions.description: May increase risk of lactic acidosis
interactions.mechanism: Loop diuretics can cause renal impairment reducing metformin clearance
interactions.management: Monitor renal function; adjust metformin dose if needed

interactions.description: Hypokalemia from furosemide increases digoxin toxicity risk
interactions.mechanism: Low potassium enhances digoxin binding to Na+/K+-ATPase
interactions.management: Monitor potassium levels; supplement potassium; monitor digoxin levels

interactions.description: Risk of severe hyperkalemia
interactions.mechanism: ACE inhibitors reduce aldosterone, potassium supplements increase K+
interactions.management: Monitor serum potassium regularly; avoid combination if possible

interactions.description: Increased simvastatin levels and myopathy risk
interactions.mechanism: Amlodipine weakly inhibits CYP3A4 metabolism of simvastatin
interactions.management: Limit simvastatin to 20mg daily; monitor for muscle symptoms

interactions.description: Severe rhabdomyolysis risk due to massive simvastatin level increase
interactions.mechanism: Clarithromycin is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor
interactions.management: Contraindicated; use alternative antibiotic or stop statin during treatment

interactions.description: Disulfiram-like reaction: nausea, vomiting, flushing, headache
interactions.mechanism: Metronidazole inhibits aldehyde dehydrogenase
interactions.management: Avoid alcohol during treatment and 48 hours after last dose

interactions.description: Phenytoin may reduce folic acid levels
interactions.mechanism: Enzyme induction increases folate metabolism
interactions.management: Monitor folate levels; supplement if needed

interactions.description: Reduced contraceptive efficacy - risk of unintended pregnancy
interactions.mechanism: Rifampicin strongly induces CYP3A4 metabolizing estrogen/progestin
interactions.management: Use alternative non-hormonal contraception during and 4 weeks after rifampicin

interactions.description: Increased methotrexate toxicity - bone marrow suppression
interactions.mechanism: Trimethoprim inhibits renal tubular secretion of methotrexate
interactions.management: Avoid combination; monitor CBC, renal and hepatic function if unavoidable

interactions.description: Increased lithium levels and toxicity risk
interactions.mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal lithium clearance
interactions.management: Monitor lithium levels closely; consider alternative analgesic

interactions.description: Increased amlodipine levels and hypotension risk
interactions.mechanism: Grapefruit inhibits CYP3A4 intestinal metabolism
interactions.management: Avoid large amounts of grapefruit; monitor blood pressure

interactions.description: Reduced levothyroxine absorption
interactions.mechanism: Calcium binds thyroxine in GI tract
interactions.management: Separate administration by at least 4 hours

interactions.description: Reduced ciprofloxacin absorption
interactions.mechanism: Divalent cations (Mg, Al, Ca) chelate fluoroquinolones
interactions.management: Separate by 2 hours before or 6 hours after antacids

interactions.description: Severe hypotension, cardiovascular collapse risk
interactions.mechanism: Both cause potent vasodilation via cGMP pathway
interactions.management: Absolutely contraindicated; wait 24h after nitrate before PDE5 inhibitor

interactions.description: Severe hyperkalemia risk
interactions.mechanism: Potassium-sparing diuretic + potassium supplement
interactions.management: Avoid combination; monitor potassium if unavoidable

interactions.description: Severe bone marrow suppression
interactions.mechanism: Allopurinol inhibits xanthine oxidase which metabolizes azathioprine
interactions.management: Reduce azathioprine dose to 25-33%; monitor CBC weekly initially

interactions.description: Serotonin syndrome risk
interactions.mechanism: Both increase serotonin - SSRI + SNRI-like effect of tramadol
interactions.management: Avoid combination; monitor for confusion, hyperreflexia, fever

interactions.description: Increased methotrexate levels and toxicity
interactions.mechanism: NSAIDs compete for renal tubular secretion
interactions.management: Monitor CBC, renal and hepatic function; avoid high-dose NSAIDs

interactions.description: Reduced antihypertensive effect and renal impairment risk
interactions.mechanism: NSAIDs inhibit prostaglandin-mediated vasodilation
interactions.management: Monitor blood pressure and renal function; consider alternative analgesic
